description: You can compare independent classes against a runtime-checkable protocol.

steps.description: Drawable declares a draw method. runtime_checkable permits the displayed isinstance checks against this protocol.
Circle and Blob each define draw. Rock defines roll instead.

steps.answer: It accepts Circle and Blob. It rejects Rock.
steps.question: Which of the three objects will the displayed protocol check accept?

steps.description: The output reports True, True, and False. Circle and Blob satisfy this method-presence check without inheriting from Drawable.

title: Check a protocol by method presence
